description:
A collection of all the messages in the chat. Nullable.

TIP: Gets a specific message in a chat by ID. Returns full message details including body content, attachments (with embedded image URLs), reactions, replies (via $expand). Use after list-chat-messages identified a message of interest. Same legal + billing caveats as list-chat-messages.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-chat-message
